name: language-translation-tool
description: Production-ready full-stack Language Translation Tool with modular providers and secure server-side credentials.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
